notes: PARENTAGE UNCONFIRMED — LIKELY BREAK POINT OF DOCUMENTED LINE (research 2026-07-03, open question): neither the Van Name (1919) nor the Elwell/Pope (1899) published Elwell genealogies list a son named Isaac for either candidate father (Samuel Elwell, d. 1772, or his brother Jacob Elwell, d. 1773 — see note on I182381534745). This tree's chain from Isaac Elwell down to his daughter Elizabeth Elwell rests on the tree's own unsourced assertions only, pending a primary record (Salem Co. deed, will, or Quaker meeting minutes) or a full read of Van Name's book. His wife's surname, 'Paulin' (I182381534725), is plausible — the Paulin family sold land to Samuel Elwell in the 1730s-40s in the same township — but is likewise unconfirmed.
